propositions: Build and test a one-time operational script using stock git fast-export/fast-import plumbing to strip target prefixes from repository history without adding external dependencies

Prove the script on a scratch unfiltered clone before publication: verify commit/merge counts preserved, tree byte-identical after re-add, target history absent except HEAD, and pack size under 150 MB ceiling
Strip both .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, and empty commits
Dynamically derive the re-add set from git ls-tree rather than hardcoded lists, and parse fast-export data blocks by byte length to handle commit messages beginning with M or D
Refuse execution in partial (blob:none) clones with a readable error message, and verify that publication boundary responsibilities (remote tag deletion, leased force-push) remain with the A6-1 task

Assert immutability of source remote branch and protected tag before and after the dry-run rewrite, and confirm that a representative post-rewrite writer push succeeds with sub-1 MiB incremental pack growth
